title: Codex account controls refuse the Vite development UI origin (403 on /api/codex/account)
outcome: The Codex /login and /logout account dialog works from the documented Vite development UI, or the docs name the backend-served UI as the supported route for account actions, without weakening the production loopback origin check.
acceptance: Opening the account dialog from the documented Vite development UI either succeeds through an explicitly allowed development origin, or the development docs state that account actions need the backend-served UI.
The production origin check for /api/codex/account still refuses foreign origins, shown by a behaviour test.
